abstract: Anti-N-methyl-d-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis is an autoimmune encephalitis, and 46% of women with anti-NMDAR encephalitis have tumors, of which 94% are ovarian teratomas. Patients with anti-NMDAR encephalitis rarely have extra-ovarian teratomas, particularly extra-ovarian mature cystic teratomas arising from the retroperitoneum. We herein report a 27-year-old woman who was diagnosed with anti-NMDAR encephalitis caused by a teratoma arising from the retroperitoneum. In patients with anti-NMDAR encephalitis, it is important to perform a systemic search, including for extra-ovarian teratomas. Plasma exchange significantly improved the patient's clinical symptoms.
abstract_ja: 抗NMDA受容体(NMDAR)脳炎は自己免疫性脳炎であり、抗NMDA受容体脳炎を有する女性の46%に腫瘍があり、そのうち94%は卵巣奇形腫です。抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者が性腺外奇形腫、特に後腹膜から発生する性腺外成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を有することは稀です。本報告では、後腹膜から発生した奇形腫が原因の抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された27歳女性を報告します。抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者では、性腺外奇形腫を含めた全身的な検索を行うことが重要です。血漿交換により患者の臨床症状は著明に改善しました。
